decisions.statement: A new per-item rule is inactive.
A destination that is no destination is refused before the store is read.
The act that adds takes the store rather than reaching it.
Every flag is narrowed before the store is read, so a misspelling reads nothing.
A rule added is named on the caller's list as soon as that write has gone.
A rule the store would not take is named nowhere, because nothing was written.
Nothing the web alone shows reaches the addon.
`--stock-scope` is taken here and refused, since an item rule carries no scope.

definition: the command adding a per-item rule
